component.name: Zoog
component.summary: Sound browser, looper, and CLAP host for the Arturia MiniLab 3

description.p: Zoog gives the Arturia MiniLab 3 a native Linux workflow: browse a searchable preset library from the hardware or the screen, play CLAP instruments with low latency, and shape the sound with the eight encoders and four faders while the device display follows along.

ul.li: Preset browsing from the controller, with display feedback
Per-engine macro mappings with soft takeover, so values never jump
A MIDI phrase looper on the transport pads
Eight loop slots on the pads, each keeping the preset it was recorded with
Automatic recovery from controller hotplug and audio stream loss

description.p: Surge XT and Odin2 work out of the box; other CLAP instruments are discovered automatically. Zoog is not affiliated with or endorsed by Arturia.

screenshot.caption: Preset library and the macro panel mirroring the hardware
Loop-slot mode, with each pad an independent loop

description.p: First release: preset browsing, macro control, the phrase looper, and eight loop slots that each keep their own preset.
